s1.syndrome_frame: Congenital skin disorder with blistering and hyperkeratotic lesions
salient_findings: Hyperkeratotic plaques with distinct borders and annular appearance
Bullae and vesicles on the face, trunk, and extremities
key_facts: Normal growth and development for age and sex
Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities
Skin-punch biopsy revealed hyperkeratosis and bullae formation within the epidermis
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1

raw.syndrome_frame: Congenital skin disorder with blistering and hyperkeratotic lesions
salient_findings: Hyperkeratotic plaques with distinct borders and annular appearance
Bullae and vesicles on the face, trunk, and extremities
key_facts: Normal growth and development for age and sex
Multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities
Skin-punch biopsy revealed hyperkeratosis and bullae formation within the epidermis
Whole-exome sequencing revealed a heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1

differentials: Focal palmoplantar keratoderma with oral mucosal hyperkeratosis
Keratosis linearis with ichthyosis congenita and sclerosing keratoderma
per_call: Focal palmoplantar keratoderma with oral mucosal hyperkeratosis
Keratosis linearis with ichthyosis congenita and sclerosing keratoderma

shortlist.label: Epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma)
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of hyperkeratotic plaques, erythema, and bullae, along with genetic testing revealing a heterozygous variation in KRT1

shortlist.label: Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical features of hyperkeratotic plaques and bullae, although less common than epidermolytic ichthyosis

shortlist.label: Bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical presentation, but epidermolytic ichthyosis is a more specific diagnosis given the genetic findings

shortlist.label: Keratinopathic ichthyosis
shortlist.why_kept: Given the involvement of KRT1 gene and clinical features of ichthyosis

shortlist.label: Pachyonychia congenita
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical features of hyperkeratotic plaques and palmoplantar hyperkeratosis, although less likely given the specific genetic findings

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of multiple areas of erythema, vesicles, and bullae on the face, trunk, and extremities, along with skin-punch biopsy revealing hyperkeratosis and bullae formation within the epidermis, and the genetic testing showing a heterozygous variation in KRT1, are consistent with epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma).

rejected.label: Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens
rejected.why: The clinical features and genetic findings do not specifically align with this condition.

rejected.label: Bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma
rejected.why: This is another term for epidermolytic ichthyosis, but the genetic findings and biopsy results more specifically support epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma).

rejected.label: Keratinopathic ichthyosis
rejected.why: While the genetic variation in KRT1 suggests a keratinopathy, the specific clinical and histopathological features are more characteristic of epidermolytic ichthyosis.

rejected.label: Pachyonychia congenita
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and genetic findings do not align with pachyonychia congenita, which typically involves thickened nails and other distinct features not mentioned in the case.
